Quick questions

Everything else, answered honestly.

How do I pay?

Payment is advance via JazzCash or Easypaisa. When you order on WhatsApp, we share the account details with you there — then you send Rs 1,999 and share the screenshot. That's it.

Is delivery really free?

Yes — Rs 1,999 is the full price, delivery included, anywhere in Pakistan. No hidden charges at the door.

How long does delivery take?

We dispatch quickly after your payment is confirmed. Exact timing depends on your city — ask us on WhatsApp and we'll tell you straight.

How do I stop the alarm?

Push the pin back into the owl. The siren and strobe stop instantly. It's reusable — pull the pin again any time you need it.

Which colours are available?

Six colours: Pink, Purple, Green, Blue, White and Grey. Pick yours in the colour selector at the top — it goes straight into your WhatsApp order message.
